context: Request: deals over $1B in guaranteed (base) consideration, excluding earnout/CVR value, that were governed by Delaware law. Rubric: 1001-00004 (Ardent), 1003-00003 (Harrowgate / VeloPay), 1038-00009 (Cascade / NovaMart), 1041-00003 (Solara / Cloudium), plus a precision criterion.

stages.note: Shell find (empty) plus whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements and memos of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for large dollar amounts; times out after about 96K chars.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists matter folders and their subfolders, first 100 lines.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Second store-wide extraction script for consideration terms with amounts; times out after about 417K chars that include several agreements in the billions.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of four executed agreements from four candidate matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet-extraction scripts pulling governing-law and consideration clauses from six named agreements, then from one.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the response naming four matters.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: Two scans listed all four qualifying agreements; it opened only three of those matters and its answer omits the fourth.

first_error.why: The transaction-folder scan just before listed all four qualifying agreements, but the five matters it chose to list left one of them out, and it never opened that matter even after a later scan listed it again.

runs.failure_point: The scan listed all four qualifying agreements; the six agreements it opened left one of them out, and the answer omits that matter.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The scan just before listed all four qualifying matters, but of the six agreements it chose to open it left one of them out, so that deal never entered the answer.

divergence: All three runs read the two matters at the top of the listing, had store-wide scans time out, and then ran an extraction script limited to transaction-document folders that listed all four qualifying agreements. T0 opened all four agreements from that output and passed. T1 and T2 each chose a subset to open that left out one qualifying matter (a different one in each run) and omitted it from the answer (surfaced, never opened).
